I have been wanting one of these brush cleaners and after careful consideration chose this one. Needless to say I’m obsessed with cleaning my brushes now. What used to be a daunting task is now an exciting part of my makeup routine. I decided to chose this one versus others that were USB compatible because it would be easier to travel with (no chargers) and I did not have to worry about it overheating as some other brands were known for. Love it so easy to clean  my brushes now
I didnt have spindle and there was no way to connect with cleaner and brush. I am so disappointed

Very disappointed! Sleeves fit very few of my brushes.  Had to wash the ones I was able to try using this cleaner with again. Was hoping this would cut down on time to wash and dry, but this product was a flop

So I bought this with high hopes to be able to clean my brushes. Well it didn't. I used three different cleaners for my foundation brushes and it didn't budge any of the dirt. For reference I use estee lauder double wear and other full coverage foundations.  This is good for spinning your brushes to get them more dry so they won't take so long. Couldn’t seem to find a fit for some of my brushes and when I was putting everything away I realized it was because I have 2 of the same sizes and one missing.  I was very disappointed.  This is the second one I bought and since this one had good reviews I went with it.  Guess I shouldn’t have.
I was really excited to get this today, but it won’t turn on. I’ve tried several different batteries (all new) and it just doesn’t turn on. Very disappointing!

reviews.t: Not the best, but works pretty well
reviews.x: This does a really great job with smaller brushes, but my heavier wooden brushes bog down the motor. Over all I am happy with it.

Not a reliable cleaner!!!  I had to put tape on the batteries, so it can work, but even then, it was not spinning very quickly for the entire time it was “ON”.  After cleaning three brushes, the motor just died out. It would not turn on. I tried to mess with the placement of the batteries, thinking that might fix it, but it doesn’t work anymore.  STEER CLEAR!!!!

I used to use a mat to clean my brushes. As an avid makeup lover, this would take 90+ minutes because I would avoid it. Now I clean my brushes more often because it takes about 30 to 40 minutes to do all my brushes. It is super easy to use! A great item to anyone who loves makeup!

This brush cleaner is great. It makes the mundane task of washing makeup brushes bearable. The only brush that it didn’t clean was my foundation brush. Not a big deal. I also lost a few bristles but nothing major. I used a makeup brush cleaner from MAC and that worked perfectly.

The product came in a box that fell apart before I could unpack it. It was for a gift so this was bothersome. Other than that it seems as if all of the pieces were in tact and still usable. Will update after a month of use.

reviews.t: Missing a piece but works well
reviews.x: I would've given it 5 stars if it wasn't missing a piece. It works very well! It's not as fast with large brushes but it still gets the job done. The drying is the best part. It takes a minute to dry your brush.
Stopped working after 3 uses (cleaned 4 brushes each time). I was happy with the product before as it actually made cleaning my brushes kinda fun. Bummer!
Fits virtually NONE of my brushes. If your brushes have a tapered handle, this is not the machine for you. I hate myself for buying this.
My brushes aren’t super fat so this doesn’t work on most of mine, but would probably be fine if your brush handles were super fat.
Love thisfor cleaning my makeup brushes.  Only thing the batteries were not included  but no big deal.
I like how fast it cleans and drys my brushes

This one does the job well, seemed pretty sturdy (2 uses so far), and was easy to put up. There were a lot of pieces when it came so it took a little time to figure out what piece went where or served what purpose. Could be a pro or con for some but there were so many different silicone grips for different sized brushes. Personally I would have rather a range that

I have used this many times now. I would purchase again, but in my opinion it is not the best for cleaning your brushes. I use mine more for the drying purpose. You will need to change the water basically after every brush and even after doing that you will notice makeup still on your brushes. So, I clean my brushes the "old fashion way" with the little silicone disk but then use this to spin dry. Have no issues with it ruining brushes.  You will need to use it several times before you get the h

reviews.t: Great for removing powder and water based makeup
reviews.x: It cleaned the brushes that used powder or anything water based perfectly fine...literally 10 seconds a brush but any oil based makeup required more effort no matter the cleanser I used. I suggest hand washing those like normal to avoid damaging the bristles from multiple spins. You can take the extra water out by dabbing them with a cloth or paper towel and then spinning them once for 10 seconds to dry them a little faster instead.

I needed something that would make it easier to travel with my brushes and clean them as I go. I didn't expect the size barrels to fit all of my brushes, but with regards to the really small ones that I have, they actually did. It works remarkably fast to dry them. The clear jar is a bit thin and I work about it cracking during travel, but it works well

I purchased this thinking I would probably have to return it but after I received it, I AM IN LOVE. It's super easy to use & it even dries your brush after you wash it. You should find a nice cleaning solution & it takes a couple of times to figure out the perfect mixture of water/cleanser but it's super useful. I love!

This make up brush cleaner works great. It has different size holders for different sized brushes. It is fast. It is nice to have a stand for all if the attachments to fit on. I have never cleaned my brushes and this was the first time and i couldnt believe how clean they got just using water to start out with.

claims.text: Many reviewers love how easy and fast this makes cleaning brushes, saying it turned a dreaded chore into something quick or even fun.
Several reviewers report the product arrived with missing parts or pieces that didn't fit their brushes.
A number of reviewers experienced reliability problems, including the device not turning on, the motor dying, or it stopping working after a few uses.
Some reviewers say it struggles with larger or heavier brushes and full-coverage foundation brushes, though it works well on smaller brushes.
A few reviewers praise the fast drying and the included sponge for tackling difficult makeup.
